inspected_images.description: Image id of every attached image the reviewer opened and inspected.

positive_observations.description: What already works, each tied to the image id it was seen on.

key.description: Stable kebab-case key for this root cause, for example hold-locked-state-unclear.

priority.description: 1 blocks play or clarity, 2 significant confusion, 3 polish, 4 minor, 5 nit.

image_ids.description: Exact packet image ids that show the problem.

region.description: Affected screen region in canvas coordinates or panel name.

observed_problem.description: What the image shows, separate from why it matters.

evidence_type.description: direct for what the pixels show, inferred for judgment built on it.

proposed_improvement.description: A concrete change inside the approved scope.

reproduction_steps.description: How to reach the frame again, from the manifest session and steps.

acceptance_criteria.description: What a fixed frame shows, observably.

affected_files.description: Repository paths the change would touch, or an empty list.

limitations.description: What this review cannot establish from static images.
